prompt:
The section file sections/announcement-bar-case.liquid renders an announcement bar. Its markup is correct and must stay exactly as it is. The markup reads section.settings.enable_bar, section.settings.alignment (used as a CSS modifier: left, center or right), section.settings.bar_color and section.settings.text_color. It compares block.type with the exact lowercase strings 'message' and 'promo_code', and reads block.settings.text, block.settings.link, block.settings.caption and block.settings.code.

The current schema uses identifiers with the wrong letter case. Setting ids, block types and select values are matched case-sensitively, so nothing renders. Only the JSON inside the single {% schema %}...{% endschema %} block may change. Every string below is case-sensitive and must be reproduced exactly, including capitalization in names, labels and defaults.

The required schema is the following, with keys and array items in the order listed:

Top level: "name": "Announcement bar" (capital A, lowercase b), "tag": "aside", "class": "announcement-bar-section", "max_blocks": 3, then "settings", "blocks" and "presets".

settings, in this order:
1. type "checkbox", id "enable_bar", label "Show announcement bar", default true (a JSON boolean).
2. type "select", id "alignment", label "Text alignment". options in this order: value "left" with label "Left", value "center" with label "Center", value "right" with label "Right". Values are lowercase and labels are capitalized. default "center".
3. type "color", id "bar_color", label "Bar color", default "#121212".
4. type "color", id "text_color", label "Text color", default "#FFFFFF" (uppercase hex digits).

blocks, in this order:
- type "message", name "Message", settings: [type "text", id "text", label "Message text", default "Free shipping on orders over $50"], [type "url", id "link", label "Link"]. The url setting has no default key. This block has no limit key.
- type "promo_code", name "Promo code" (lowercase c), limit 1 (a number), settings: [type "text", id "caption", label "Caption", default "Use code"], [type "text", id "code", label "Code", default "WELCOME10" (uppercase)].

Within every setting object, use the key order type, id, label, then any remaining keys. Within block objects, use the key order type, name, limit (where present), settings.

presets: exactly one preset, with name "Announcement bar" and blocks [{"type": "message"}, {"type": "promo_code"}]. The preset block types must use the same exact case as the block definitions.

Do not add any other keys. Change only sections/announcement-bar-case.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
